description: This PHP script manages module settings in the vtiger CRM system, including module enabling/disabling, language access toggling, file inclusion for module settings, and rendering the module management interface.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Smarty template engine class used for rendering the interface.

methods.name: Vtiger_Utils::checkFileAccessForInclusion
methods.description: Checks if a file can be included based on access permissions.

methods.name: checkFileAccess
methods.description: Checks file access permissions for a given filename.

methods.name: vtlib_toggleLanguageAccess
methods.description: Enables or disables language module access.

methods.name: vtlib_toggleModuleAccess
methods.description: Enables or disables general module access.

methods.name: vtlib_isDirWriteable
methods.description: Checks if a directory is writable.

methods.name: vtlib_getToggleLanguageInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about toggleable language modules.

methods.name: vtlib_purify
methods.description: Sanitizes input data to prevent security issues.
